lines.english: Suppose a sacred sword lay sleeping there, with the power to break the deadlock.

lines.japanese: （誰が、それを手にできる？）
lines.english: (Who could ever take it up?)

lines.japanese:
引き返すべきだ。
　忍は思った。
lines.english: He should turn back, Shinobu thought.

lines.japanese:
意識からの視点であるからには、思うことは
イコール行動となる。
lines.english: Within consciousness, thought and action were one and the same.

lines.japanese: 引き返すべきだった。
lines.english: He should have turned back.

lines.japanese:
その瞬間、忍の恐怖が限界線を越えた―――
　だが―――
lines.english: At that instant, Shinobu's terror crossed its final threshold— But—

lines.japanese: 輝く天井部から、水滴が落ちてきた。
lines.english: A droplet fell from the shining ceiling above.

lines.japanese:
無論、物質ではない。
　手にとって、理解した。
　粒子の水滴だったのだ。
lines.english: It was not matter, of course. He took it in hand and understood. It was a droplet made of particles.

lines.japanese:
そのささやかな意識の元は、涙一粒分の記憶を
宿していた。
lines.english: That tiny kernel of consciousness held a single tear’s worth of memory.
“...You prom...ised... so... you really... ...will... right?”

lines.japanese:
その瞬間、灰野と千鳥の行為が思い返された。
　怒りが、恐怖を超えた。
lines.english: At that instant, he remembered what Haino was doing to Chidori. His anger rose above his fear.

lines.japanese: （……そうだ、まだだ……）
lines.english: (...That's right. Not yet...)

lines.japanese: 突如として、意識が引かれた。
lines.english: Without warning, his consciousness was pulled.

lines.japanese:
再び、沈む。
　怯えはない。
　むしろ望んで、深海へと身を投げた。
lines.english: He sank again. He was no longer afraid. Instead, he threw himself willingly into the deep sea.

lines.japanese:
深まる闇。
　上流からの輝きさえ、届かない場所へ。
lines.english: The darkness deepened. He passed beyond the reach of even the light from upstream.
(...Deep.)

lines.japanese:
果てしなく深い。
　どれほどの時を要したのか。
　実際は１秒にも満たないのだろう。
lines.english: Endlessly deep. How long had it taken him? In reality, probably less than a second.

lines.japanese:
だが主観では、何日も経過したように感じられた。
　肉体がなく五感は喪失している。
　怯えないこと。
lines.english: Subjectively, however, it felt as though days had passed. He had no body. His five senses were gone. He must not be afraid.

lines.japanese:
決意という名の擬体に恐懼が宿れば、バランスが
崩れ強度が失せる。
lines.english: If fear entered the semblance of a body he called resolve, it would lose its balance and strength.

lines.japanese: （迷うな、怯えるな）
lines.english: (Don't waver. Don't be afraid.)
(...Be angry.)

lines.japanese:
墨を流したような黒色世界を貫くには、強固で一
途な感情が必要だ。
lines.english: To pierce a world as black as spilled ink, he needed an emotion both unyielding and single-minded.

lines.japanese: 弾丸とならねばならない。
lines.english: He had to become a bullet.

lines.japanese:
加速する。
　嫉妬をその原動力として。
　第三階層へと至るために。
lines.english: He accelerated. Jealousy was his propellant. To reach the Third Stratum.

lines.japanese: 変化は不意に生じた。
lines.english: The change came without warning.

lines.japanese: （……この存在感は？）
lines.english: (...What is this presence?)

lines.japanese:
景色に変化はない。
　圧倒的な絶無。永遠の夜だ。
lines.english: The landscape had not changed. Overwhelming nonexistence. Eternal night.

lines.japanese:
しかし……この第三階層には何かがいた。
　総毛立つほどに。
lines.english: And yet... something was here in the Third Stratum. Its presence made his hair stand on end.

lines.japanese: （こんなところに？）
lines.english: (Here?)

lines.japanese:
周囲に知覚力を向ける。
　忍は瞠目した。
lines.english: He cast his perception outward. Shinobu's eyes widened.

lines.japanese: 闇の蚕。
lines.english: Silkworms of darkness.

lines.japanese:
そうとしか形容できぬものたちが、無数に浮遊し
ていた。
lines.english: Countless things that could be described no other way hung suspended in the void.

lines.japanese: （大きい……）
lines.english: (They're enormous...)

lines.japanese:
息を呑む。
　忍自身の自我と比べるとよくわかる。
lines.english: He caught his breath. Their scale became clear when he compared them to his own ego.

lines.japanese:
降下中の自我を等身大の忍と仮定すると……蚕の
一匹一匹はそれぞれ全長数十キロメートルにも達す
るだろうか。質量ならば、比率はさらに開く。
lines.english: If the descending ego were taken as a life-size Shinobu... might each silkworm measure tens of kilometers from end to end? The disparity in mass would be greater still.

lines.japanese:
サイズ・密度ともに、一個の人格とは比肩できな
い存在。
lines.english: No single personality could compare with them in either size or density.

lines.japanese:
形状は存在しない。概念としては幼虫のそれに近
い。認識が視覚と同調した結果、そう見えるに過ぎ
ない。
lines.english: They had no shape. Conceptually, they were something like larvae. They appeared that way only because perception had synchronized with vision.

lines.japanese:
彼らはあまりにも、おぞましく、無垢である。
　善でも悪でもなく、ありとあらゆる倫理から外れ
ている。
lines.english: They were unspeakably repulsive, and utterly innocent. Neither good nor evil, they stood outside every system of ethics.

lines.japanese:
自我でさえない。
　超自我とも違う。
　原始心象と言える象徴性さえ持たない。
lines.english: Not even egos. Nor were they superegos. They lacked even the symbolism that might have made them primal images.

lines.japanese:
ただそこに存在しているだけの、純粋かつ高密度
のうねりなのだ。
lines.english: They were pure, high-density undulations that did nothing but exist.

lines.japanese: （思い出した）
lines.english: (I remember.)

lines.japanese:
（沙也加が言っていたっけ……人間の心には、神々
　の仕掛けがあるって）
lines.english: (Sayaka once told me... that the human mind contains mechanisms of the gods.)

lines.japanese: 『意図されて配置されたのかどうか、私は知らない』
lines.english: “I don't know whether they were placed there by design.”

lines.japanese: 『けれど……彼らはあまりにも大きすぎる』
lines.english: “But... they are far too large.”

lines.japanese:
『個人の精神に置かれているものにしては、途方も
　ないほど』
lines.english: “Impossibly large for something housed within an individual mind.”

lines.japanese:
『私が自身の内部で見たときの、最初の印象は……
　地獄の番犬というものだったの』
lines.english: “When I first saw them inside myself... I thought of the hounds of hell.”

lines.japanese: 『そしてあれらは、誰の心にも存在している』
lines.english: “And they exist in every human mind.”

lines.japanese:
『だけど今まで、人類史においてあれが覚醒したこ
　とはほとんどない……』
lines.english: “Yet in all of human history, they have almost never awakened...”

lines.japanese: 『創造せず、破壊とも無縁の神々』
lines.english: “Gods that create nothing and have nothing to do with destruction.”

lines.japanese: 『……少なくとも、敵ではないと思いたいわね』
lines.english: “...At the very least, I'd like to believe they aren't our enemies.”

lines.japanese: （鈍い神様もあったものだけど……）
lines.english: (They make for rather sluggish gods...)

lines.japanese:
事実、空間が広すぎるため、落下する忍がそれら
に接近することはない。
lines.english: Indeed, the space was so vast that Shinobu’s fall never brought him close to any of them.

lines.japanese:
宇宙空間で、星々が互いに接触しないことに似て
いる。
lines.english: It was like stars in space never touching one another.

lines.japanese:
セキュリティとしては無防備すぎた。
　王の王たる忍の心底には、怪物たちが闊歩し、漂っ
ている。
lines.english: As a security system, it was far too defenseless. Monsters roamed and drifted through the deepest reaches of Shinobu’s mind— the mind of a king of kings.

lines.japanese:
長大なその身を、無為に波打たせながら。
　忍ばかりが異質なのではない。
lines.english: Their tremendous bodies rippled without purpose. Shinobu was not the only aberration.

lines.japanese:
人間の心には多かれ少なかれ、表層とは比肩でき
ない大質量を有する、無意識体が棲むのである。例
外はない。
lines.english: To one degree or another, every human mind housed unconscious entities whose mass dwarfed anything on the surface. There were no exceptions.

lines.japanese:
怪物が一匹でも浮上すれば、件の光網などたちま
ち突き破られてしまう。
lines.english: If even one monster rose, it would tear through the web of light in an instant.

lines.japanese:
いや、抵抗にもならないだろう。
　意識は完全に破壊される。
lines.english: No—the web would probably offer no resistance at all. Consciousness would be annihilated.

lines.japanese: 一匹だけの存在感で、世界が埋め尽くされるようだ。
lines.english: The presence of a single one seemed enough to fill the world.

lines.japanese:
とうてい許容できない膨大な情報力が意識を乗っ
取れば、物理レベルの超常現象へと至るだろう。
lines.english: If consciousness were taken over by more informational power than it could possibly bear, it would probably give rise to paranormal effects in the physical world.

lines.japanese:
狂気の、神。
　特に忍のそれは、人類規模を超えている。
lines.english: A god of madness. Shinobu's in particular exceeded the scale of humanity.

lines.japanese:
無精神世界とも言うべき深度において、まさに神
域は実現していた。
lines.english: At a depth that might be called a world without mind, the realm of the gods had truly been realized.

lines.japanese:
天文学的絶望が、そこにあった。
　……限りなく無害ではあれど。
lines.english: Despair on an astronomical scale lay there. ...Though almost wholly harmless.

lines.japanese: （小宇宙、か）
lines.english: (A microcosm...)

lines.japanese:
忍は肌で感じている。
　……彼らが上方に向かうことはないということを。
　漂い、蠢くだけだ。
lines.english: Shinobu could feel it in his skin. ...They would never rise toward the surface. They would only drift and writhe.

lines.japanese:
仮に彼らが意志を持ち、その処理能力を借りるこ
とができれば……。
lines.english: If they possessed wills—if he could borrow their power to process information...

lines.japanese: いや、と打ち消す。
lines.english: No. He rejected the thought.

lines.japanese: （無理だ……あれを制御するなんて）
lines.english: (Impossible... Controlling those things...)

lines.japanese:
彼らの存在する意味は謎である。
　認知科学が、いつか解き明かしてくれるかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: The meaning of their existence was a mystery. Perhaps cognitive science would solve it someday.

lines.japanese:
それは、遠い未来のことであり……訪れるかどう
かもわからない、無明の闇の先にある。
lines.english: It lay in the distant future... beyond the darkness of ignorance, and no one knew whether that future would ever come.

lines.japanese: 忍は降りていく。
lines.english: Shinobu continued his descent.

lines.japanese:
底の底へ。
　奥の奥へ。
　もう引き返せない。
lines.english: To the bottom beneath the bottom. To the depths beyond the depths. There was no turning back now.

lines.japanese: ようこそ。
lines.english: Welcome.

lines.japanese: ……心海へ。
lines.english: ...To the sea of the mind.

lines.japanese: 神々の気配が、頭上に遠くなった頃。
lines.english: When the presence of the gods had dwindled far overhead—

lines.japanese:
城が立ち現れた。
　装飾一つない黒い立方体を積み上げて、できている。
lines.english: a castle emerged. It was built from unadorned black cubes stacked one upon another.

lines.japanese: （とうとう来た）
lines.english: (At last.)

lines.japanese: （海溝の、底だ……）
lines.english: (The bottom of the trench...)

lines.japanese:
城は茨に覆われていた。
　成分は、表層意識で見た光網と同じものだ。
　つまりは……忍の精神活動、その電気信号である。
lines.english: The castle was smothered in thorns. They were made of the same substance as the web of light at the surface. In other words... they were the electrical signals of Shinobu's mental activity.

lines.japanese:
だが、茨と化しているそれは、肉体・精神のいず
れにも使用されていない。
lines.english: Yet in this thornlike form, those signals served neither body nor mind.

lines.japanese: 隔離されているということを、示しているようだ。
lines.english: It seemed to signify that they had been isolated.

lines.japanese:
神経伝達の茨に覆われた、心的迷宮の最深部に。
　忍は降り立った。
lines.english: Shinobu landed at the very bottom of that psychic labyrinth, amid thorns of neural transmission.

lines.japanese: （……僕の、物理・精神限界点か）
lines.english: (...The physical and mental limit of my being.)

lines.japanese:
人の心は有限。
　無限に近いが、有限。
　可能性もまた然り。
lines.english: The human mind was finite. Near-infinite, but finite. The same was true of possibility.

lines.japanese:
どれだけ文明や精神を進歩させても、いずれ辿り
着く地平。
lines.english: A horizon that would eventually be reached, no matter how far civilization or the mind advanced.

lines.japanese:
それを証明するのが、今立っている闇の大地だ。
　人はこれ以上の深みに到達できない。
lines.english: The dark earth beneath his feet was proof. Humanity could descend no deeper.

lines.japanese: （……自分が、存在している）
lines.english: (...I exist.)

lines.japanese:
重苦しい気分ではあるが、忍はまだ、自我を保っ
ていた。
lines.english: His spirits were heavy, but Shinobu still retained his ego.

lines.japanese:
心海に降りて無事でいられるなどと、考えたこと
はなかった。
lines.english: He had never imagined he could descend into the sea of the mind and remain unharmed.

lines.japanese:
（にしても、こうまで平気だというのは……己の心
　に潜る資格があるのは、自分だけだってことか）
lines.english: (And yet I’m still perfectly fine... Does that mean only I’m qualified to enter my own mind?)

lines.japanese: 故に、番犬たちも動かなかった。きっと。
lines.english: That must be why the watchdogs had not stirred.

lines.japanese:
忍は手を開く。
　知らず、鍵が握られていた。
　自身で用意したものだ。
lines.english: Shinobu opened his hand. A key lay in his palm, though he had not known he held it. He had prepared it himself.
—Eleven years ago.

lines.japanese: （……これを使えば）
lines.english: (If I use this...)

lines.japanese: 城と対面する忍。
lines.english: Shinobu stood before the castle.

lines.japanese: （僕はもう少し、悪あがきができる）
lines.english: (I can keep struggling a little longer.)

lines.japanese:
何を恐れていたのか。
　なぜ諦めていたのか。
　あがけばいい。
lines.english: What had he been afraid of? Why had he given up? He could still struggle.

lines.japanese:
たとえ、進む道筋に絶望があっても。
　涙と苦しみ、屈辱にまみれていても。
lines.english: Even if despair waited along the road ahead. Even if it was steeped in tears and anguish and humiliation.

lines.japanese: （全て、僕のものだ―――）
lines.english: (All of it is mine—)

lines.japanese:
鍵が浮いた。
　純黒の空に、ほどけて咲いた。
　原子分解と再構成を思わせて、姿を変える。
lines.english: The key floated upward. It unraveled and blossomed against the pure-black sky. As though disassembled into atoms and rebuilt, it changed shape.

lines.japanese:
手に取る。
　鍵は、忍の腕と同化した。
lines.english: He took it. The key fused with Shinobu's arm.
(What is this...?)

lines.japanese:
解錠の性能が宿ったことを、忍は感じ取った。
　鍵がなければ城には入れない。
　忍だけがそれを持つ。
lines.english: Shinobu felt that he now had the power to unlock it. Without the key, the castle could not be entered. Only Shinobu possessed it.

lines.japanese: ひとや

人類の叡智によって生成された、最後の力。
　地の底の獄でなければ、生み出すことのできなか
った力。
lines.english: The final power produced by the accumulated wisdom of humanity. A power that could only have been born in a prison at the bottom of the earth.

lines.japanese: 全能管理権限―――
lines.english: Omnipotent administrative authority—

lines.japanese:
城に触れた。
　茨が生物のように退く。
　ぽっかりと、空洞が開かれていた。
lines.english: He touched the castle. The thorns withdrew like living things. A hollow opened before him.

lines.japanese:
入城可能。
　忍は歩を進めた。
lines.english: Entry permitted. Shinobu stepped forward.

lines.japanese:
内部は空洞だった。
　聖堂ほども広い、一室のみが存在した。
　そこに。
lines.english: The interior was hollow. There was only a single chamber, vast as a cathedral. And there—

lines.japanese: 置かれているものがあった。
lines.english: something had been placed.

lines.japanese: いかなる感情も届かない、永遠の夜陰に。
lines.english: In eternal night, beyond the reach of any emotion.

lines.japanese: 置かれているものがあった。
lines.english: Something had been placed there.

lines.japanese:
手が、伸びたのだ。
　鍵と化した忍の腕。
　細く白い、無力な手だ。
lines.english: A hand reached out. Shinobu's arm, transformed into a key. A slender, white, powerless hand.

lines.japanese:
だが、心の外では不可視と化す。そう、それは現
象の腕。
lines.english: Yet beyond the mind it became invisible. Yes—it was an arm of phenomenon.

lines.japanese:
茨の森をかいくぐり、長く蛇のように伸びた腕の
先……安置されているのは。
lines.english: Beyond the tip of his arm, stretching like a serpent through the forest of thorns, lay enshrined—

lines.japanese: あるいは、そぐわないかも知れない―――
lines.english: Or perhaps that description did not fit—

lines.japanese: ＩＤカードだ。
lines.english: an ID card.
Ah—!!

lines.japanese:
歓喜。
　天光。
　万能！
lines.english: Exultation. Heavenly light. Omnipotence!

lines.japanese: それはパンドラの箱などという、惰弱な器ではない。
lines.english: This was no feeble vessel like Pandora's box.

lines.japanese: 貴宮忍最深領域に秘められていたもの……それは、
lines.english: The thing hidden in the deepest realm of Shinobu Atemiya... was—

lines.japanese: （これを手にした瞬間、僕の死が決まる）
lines.english: (The moment I take this, my death becomes certain.)

lines.japanese:
（下手をすれば、最後の日まで保たない……
　それほどに負担を背負う）
lines.english: (If things go badly, I won’t even last until the final day... That is how great a burden I’ll bear.)

lines.japanese:
（だからなのかな。
　僕の予見が、未来を映せないのは）
lines.english: (Could that be why... my foresight shows me no future?)

lines.japanese:
（こうなることは、決まっていたのかも……
　悔しいけれど）
lines.english: (Maybe this was always going to happen... Much as I hate to admit it.)

lines.japanese: （でも、やるね……章二）
lines.english: (Still... well played, Shouji.)

lines.japanese: （全て、僕のものにしてしまうよ）
lines.english: (I'll make it all mine.)

lines.japanese: （奴らに消費されてしまうくらいなら）
lines.english: (Better that than letting them consume it.)

lines.japanese: （僕のものに―――）
lines.english: (Mine—)

lines.japanese:
（在りし日に世界征服を嘯いた、愚かな君に敬意を
　表し）
lines.english: (In tribute to the fool you were, who once boasted that he would conquer the world—)

lines.japanese: （世界を、君の好み求めた聖域に、組み替える）
lines.english: (I'll remake that world into the sanctuary you longed for.)

lines.japanese: （敵に一太刀）
lines.english: (A single stroke against the enemy.)

lines.japanese: そのためには？
lines.english: And what would that require?

lines.japanese: 対神対識高次病原概念『CODE-T』―――
lines.english: The higher-order anti-god, anti-consciousness pathogenic concept CODE-T—

hyperlinks.preview: CODE-Tragedy— A code pointing to a tragic ending.

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: CODE-Tragedy— A code pointing to a tragic ending.

lines.japanese:
生体ウイルス。
　かつて忍が用意した、切り札。
　その解析に、１１年を要するとされた。
lines.english: A biological virus. The trump card Shinobu had prepared long ago. It was said that analyzing it would require eleven years.

lines.japanese: （そうか、だから……かつての僕は……）
lines.english: (I see. That's why... the person I was back then...)

lines.japanese: ノイズ。
lines.english: Noise.

lines.japanese: 今はまだ、知る必要もないことだ。
lines.english: It was not something he needed to know yet.

lines.japanese:
どれだけ防壁があろうとも、敵に逆探知される可
能性はあるのだから。
lines.english: No matter how many barriers stood in the way, there was always a chance the enemy could trace the signal back.

lines.japanese: 虚ろの神々たちの腹の下に、置いておけば良い。
lines.english: Better to leave it beneath the bellies of the hollow gods.

lines.japanese: （なら、今すべきことは一つだ）
lines.english: (Then there is only one thing to do now.)

lines.japanese:
手を伸ばす。
　カードを掴む。
　そしてはじめて、命令文を発した。
lines.english: He reached out. Seized the card. And for the first time, he uttered the command.

lines.japanese: 「Omnipoten Network Management Protocol」
lines.english: “Omnipoten Network Management Protocol”

lines.japanese:
世界の王たちが目指した境地、人類統一の確約と
ともに、
lines.english: Together with the promise of human unification—the destination sought by the kings of the world—

lines.japanese: 貴宮忍、起動―――
lines.english: Shinobu Atemiya: activate—

lines.japanese:
過酷な時が来ようとしていた。
　だがそれさえも、終末に比べれば、許し得るもの
と言えた。
lines.english: Cruel days were drawing near. Yet even they could be called tolerable beside the end of the world.

lines.japanese:
結末の世界では、人類史におけるどのような犯罪
行為も許される。
lines.english: In a world at its ending, every crime in human history could be forgiven.

lines.japanese:
悪逆非道な行いも、演じられるべき舞台が消失し
てしまうのであれば、無である。
lines.english: Even the most atrocious act became nothing if the stage on which it was played would itself cease to exist.

lines.japanese:
今の苦しみ、そして如何なる犠牲も……過程に過
ぎない。
lines.english: The suffering of the present, and every conceivable sacrifice... were no more than parts of the process.

lines.japanese:
だから確定された破局に対し、人はどのような非
人道的手段をも講じることができた。
lines.english: And so, in the face of certain catastrophe, humanity was free to employ any means, however inhuman.

lines.japanese:
犠牲が出ることがわかっている作戦。
　それに従事……否、主導するという立場の忍だ。
lines.english: It was an operation certain to claim lives. And Shinobu would take part in it—no, he would command it.

lines.japanese:
王の王たる責務として。
　期待されるのは、奇跡でしかない。
　犠牲のない、完全無欠の勝利だ。
lines.english: Such was his duty as king of kings. Nothing less than a miracle was expected of him. Perfect victory, without a single sacrifice.

lines.japanese:
勝てば……また人は、終わらない楽園に身を置け
るのだから。
lines.english: For if they won... humanity could return once more to its endless paradise.

lines.japanese:
人同士の、他愛ない営為に耽ることができる。
　殺すこと、盗むこと、欺くこと、犯すこと。
lines.english: People could lose themselves again in their trivial human pursuits: killing, stealing, deceiving, violating.

lines.japanese:
なべて幸多きことだと言えた。
　残念ながら、人は神ではなかった。
　人の世に神はなく。
lines.english: All of it could be called happiness. Unfortunately, humans were not gods. No gods in the human world.

lines.japanese:
神なき世界に奇跡なし。
　人類が絞り出したのは、大多数の犠牲をもって、
ごく少数を生存させる方法だった。
lines.english: No miracles in a world without gods. All humanity had wrung from itself was a way to preserve a tiny few through the sacrifice of the many.

lines.japanese:
他に手はない。
　現象に触れ、事象を成して、到達すべき人造奇跡。
lines.english: There was no other way. The man-made miracle to be reached by touching phenomena and shaping events.

lines.japanese:
そのためのＵＳＥＲであり、ＧＶＰであり、
貴宮忍であった。
lines.english: That was what USERs, the GVP, and Shinobu Atemiya were for.

lines.japanese: 「隊長くーん」
lines.english: “Caaap!”

lines.japanese: 廊下でシャーリーと出会う。
lines.english: He ran into Shirley in the hallway.

lines.japanese: 「君か」
lines.english: “You.”

lines.japanese: 「キミでーす！」
lines.english: “That's meee!”

lines.japanese: 「元気だね」
lines.english: “You’re full of energy.”

lines.japanese: 「煮えたぎる衝動が、俺を突き動かすのです」
lines.english: “A seething impulse drives me ever onward!”

lines.japanese: 「そう。頑張って」
lines.english: “I see. Good luck with that.”

lines.japanese: 立ち去ろうとする。
lines.english: He turned to leave.

lines.japanese: 「……お茶しよ、見捨てないで……」
lines.english: “...Have tea with me. Don't abandon me...”

lines.japanese: 「裾を引っ張らないで」
lines.english: “Stop tugging at the hem.”

lines.japanese: 「お茶だって？」
lines.english: “Tea?”

lines.japanese: 「たまには」
lines.english: “Once in a while.”

lines.japanese: お茶会―――
lines.english: A tea party—

lines.japanese: 「いいけど……」
lines.english: “All right, but...”

lines.japanese:
つい。
　うなずいてしまう。
lines.english: Without meaning to, he nodded.

lines.japanese: 「いいお店、知ってるんですよ」
lines.english: “I know a wonderful place.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そー」
lines.english: “Uh-huh. Sure.”

lines.japanese:
出られるはずはない。
　だから、二人は食堂に行くしかないのだった。
lines.english: There was no possible way for them to leave. Which meant they had no choice but to go to the cafeteria.

lines.japanese: 腕を組んできた。
lines.english: She linked her arm through his.

lines.japanese:
不意に、忍は感情的になった。
　コントロールしようとさえ、思えなかった。
lines.english: A sudden rush of emotion swept through Shinobu. It did not even occur to him to control it.

lines.japanese: 「ぬい？」
lines.english: “Myeah?”

lines.japanese: 「君が求めているものは―――」
lines.english: “What you're looking for—”

lines.japanese:
予定されていたのは、否定の言葉だった。
　拒絶の言葉だった。
lines.english: What he had meant to say was a denial. A rejection.

lines.japanese:
あまりにも強固で狭窄な忍の聖域に、誰も入るこ
とはできない。
lines.english: No one could enter the sanctuary Shinobu kept so narrow and so tightly sealed.

lines.japanese: それを少女に告げようとした瞬間、
lines.english: At the very moment he tried to tell the girl—

lines.japanese: 冷水となって、忍を沈黙させる。
lines.english: Like a dousing of cold water, her presence silenced Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「……どうも」
lines.english: “...Hello.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Hello.”

lines.japanese: すれ違う。
lines.english: They passed each other.

lines.japanese:
書類を胸元に抱えた彼女は、教師然としていて……
思い出す。
lines.english: With papers clasped to her chest, she had the air of a teacher... and something came back to him.
“...Chief.”

lines.japanese: 千鳥の足が止まる。
lines.english: Chidori stopped.

lines.japanese: 「なんでしょう？」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese:
言葉はない。
　彼女のしていること。されていること。
　そこに忍が関わっていること。
lines.english: There were no words. What she did. What was done to her. And Shinobu's part in it.

lines.japanese:
事実関係などは、枝葉末節なのだろう。
　要するに、忍の取り合いである。
　ドライで実利的な、ゼロサム・ゲーム。
lines.english: The facts themselves were probably beside the point. At heart, this was a struggle over Shinobu. A dry and practical zero-sum game.

lines.japanese:
千鳥が忍にしてきたことの全ては、確かに彼女に
よってメリットになってきた。
lines.english: Everything Chidori had done to Shinobu had unquestionably brought her some benefit.

lines.japanese:
だとしても……気持ちがないとは、言い切れない。
今は。
lines.english: Even so... he could no longer say with certainty that she felt nothing. Not now.

lines.japanese: だから忍も、何も言えなかった。
lines.english: And so Shinobu could say nothing either.

lines.japanese:
―――あの日。
　気がつけば、自室の寝台で眠っていた。
　気を失っていたのかも知れない。
lines.english: —That day. He had awakened in the bed in his room. Perhaps he had lost consciousness.

lines.japanese: 「いえ、なんでもありません」
lines.english: “No. It's nothing.”

lines.japanese:
千鳥は去っていく。
　感情一つ見せないままに。
lines.english: Chidori walked away. Without showing a trace of emotion.

lines.japanese: 「貴宮くん？」
lines.english: “Atemiya?”

lines.japanese:
少年は思う。
　大切なものを持つことはできない。
　誰もが、忍に対してそんな権利は認めはしない。
lines.english: The boy thought. He was not allowed to possess anything precious. No one would grant Shinobu that right.

lines.japanese:
罪のゆえに。
　忍が犯した、決して許されない、絶対的な悪。
lines.english: Because of his sin. The absolute, unforgivable evil Shinobu had committed.

lines.japanese:
ありとあらゆる者たちにとって、決して許しては
いけない行為だったからだ。
lines.english: Because it was an act that no one—no one at all—must ever forgive.

lines.japanese: そう、許してはいけない。
lines.english: Yes. It must not be forgiven.

lines.japanese: 「許してはいけない」
lines.english: “It must not be forgiven.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「侵略行為を、許してはいけない」
lines.english: “An act of invasion must not be forgiven.”

lines.japanese: シャーリーは少し考えた。
lines.english: Shirley gave that some thought.

lines.japanese: 「なんだかよくわからないけど、そうですね」
lines.english: “I'm not sure I understand, but yes. I agree.”

lines.japanese: きっとわかってない。
lines.english: She almost certainly did not understand.

lines.japanese:
「銃を持った相手を制するのは、銃だけ……だけど
　そういうのとも、違うよなぁ」
lines.english: “Only a gun can stop someone with a gun... but this isn't quite the same, is it?”

lines.japanese: 「どこらへんがですか？」
lines.english: “Which part isn't?”

lines.japanese:
「ある王様が、国民を守るために国民を徴兵できちゃ
　うってのがさ……どうなんだってことだよ」
lines.english: “A king can conscript his own people in order to protect them. What are we supposed to make of that?”

lines.japanese: 「王様って隊長くんのことですか？」
lines.english: “By ‘king,’ do you mean you, Cap?”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese:
「わたしたち、ううん、わたしは失格しちゃったけ
　ど……みんな自分でやってることだと思いますよ、
　これって」
lines.english: “We all—no, I washed out, but... I think everyone’s doing this by choice.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう人も、多いだろうけどさ」
lines.english: “Probably plenty of them are, but...”

lines.japanese:
「要するに、みんな自分一人一人の聖域ってのがあ
　って、それを冒涜するのはもっともやっちゃいけ
　ないことって論理が……」
lines.english: “What I mean is, everyone has a sanctuary of their own, and the rule that violating it is the one thing no one must ever do...”

lines.japanese: 「たぶん今の絶対的な正義だと思うから」
lines.english: “That is probably the absolute justice of our time.”

lines.japanese: 「話がむずかしくなった……」
lines.english: “This is getting complicated...”

lines.japanese:
「友情を強いるとか、愛情を押しつけるとか……昔
　だったら美談だったそれは、もう余計なお世話っ
　てことだよ」
lines.english: “Demanding friendship, forcing your love on someone... Once upon a time, that sort of thing made for a touching story. Now it’s just unwanted interference.”

lines.japanese:
「最近は友情というか、自分が認めたかどうかーて
　ことですよね」
lines.english: “These days, friendship is more about whether you've accepted someone, isn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「踏み込まないことが正義なんだよ。善し悪しじゃ
　ない。昔より、今の方がずっと自分が大切になっ
　てる」
lines.english: “Not intruding is what's right. It isn't a matter of good or bad. We value the self far more now than we did in the past.”

lines.japanese:
「命はおろか、意見や考え方も、自分だけのものな
　んだ」
lines.english: “Not just your life—even your opinions and your way of thinking belong to you alone.”

lines.japanese: 「それを侵害するから、敵対することになる」
lines.english: “Violating those things is what turns us into enemies.”

lines.japanese: 「……誰かの心に土足で踏み込んだりしたことが？」
lines.english: “...Have you ever barged into someone’s heart and trampled all over it?”

lines.japanese:
「ないよ。いや、あるかも知れないけど……基本的
　には僕だって、自分が大切だ」
lines.english: “No. Well, maybe I have... but generally speaking, I care about myself too.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ……これからはどうなるかわからない」
lines.english: “I just... don't know what will happen now.”

lines.japanese:
忍の顔を、頭に問題を抱えた者とは思えない深く
澄んだ瞳で、シャーリーは見つめた。
lines.english: Shirley gazed at Shinobu with eyes so deep and clear that no one could have imagined there was anything wrong with her mind.

lines.japanese:
「……隊長くんは、いつも難しいこと考えてるんで
　すね」
lines.english: “...You're always thinking about such difficult things, aren't you, Cap?”

lines.japanese: 少し不快だった。
lines.english: That annoyed him a little.

lines.japanese:
シャーリーとは別れ、外へ出る。
　呆れるほどに青く抜けた空がそこにはあった。
lines.english: He left Shirley and went outside. An absurdly clear blue sky was waiting for him.

lines.japanese:
あまりにも蒼然とした大気には、予兆という役目
が割り振られている。
　……としか思えない。
lines.english: The air was so starkly blue that it seemed to have been assigned the role of omen. ...There was no other way to read it.

lines.japanese:
忍は立って、空を見ていた。
　いつものように。
lines.english: Shinobu stood and watched the sky. As he always did.

lines.japanese:
唯一、いつもと違うことと言えば。
　行為に、意味があったこと。
lines.english: Only one thing was different from usual. This time, the act had meaning.

lines.japanese: 目を、凝らす。
lines.english: He strained his eyes.

lines.japanese:
世界を感じ取ることができる。
　おぼろげに。
lines.english: He could feel the world. Dimly.

lines.japanese: 感じ取る―――
lines.english: He felt it—

lines.english: Shinobu did not know the exact human population. Six billion? Seven? Perhaps more.

lines.japanese:
予見は自身の死しか告げてはくれないが、未知の
敵に対抗するには人類は未完成であり、彼らと同種
の干渉手段は忍にしか制御できない。
lines.english: His foresight showed him only his own death. But humanity was not ready to oppose the unknown enemy, and only Shinobu could control a means of interference like theirs.

lines.japanese: よって、人はほとんどが死滅することになるだろう。
lines.english: Most of humanity would therefore probably perish.

lines.japanese: 頭痛は小康状態に入ってくれた。
lines.english: The headache had subsided for the time being.

lines.japanese:
邑西らによって施された数々の処置が、功を奏し
たのかどうか。
lines.english: Had the many treatments Yuuzai and the others had administered done some good?

lines.japanese: ともあれ、思考に集中できるのはありがたい。
lines.english: Whatever the cause, he was grateful to be able to think.

lines.japanese: （だけど、熱はあるな）
lines.english: (I still have a fever, though.)

lines.japanese:
額を押さえる。
　常時、微熱があるようだ。
lines.english: He pressed a hand to his forehead. A mild fever seemed to be his constant state now.

lines.japanese:
身体が気怠い。
　熱のため、代謝が活発になっているせいだろう。
lines.english: His body felt heavy. The heat had probably accelerated his metabolism.

lines.japanese:
体温はわずか一度の上昇でも、人体にはかなりの
負担となる。
lines.english: Even a rise of a single degree Celsius placed a considerable strain on the human body.

lines.japanese:
頭痛もなく、多少の熱であれば好調といっても差
し支えないレベルである。
lines.english: Without a headache, and with only a little fever, he could reasonably call himself in good condition.

lines.japanese:
が、知らず４２度を超えてしまわないよう、時に
は自律生化学的なアプローチも必要だ。
lines.english: Still, to ensure he did not drift past 42 degrees Celsius without noticing, he would occasionally need to regulate his own biochemistry.

hyperlinks.preview: It is well known that thermometers have no markings above 42°C. The reason, of course, is that the h

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: It is well known that thermometers have no markings above 42°C. The reason, of course, is that the h

lines.japanese: （熱があるのは……処理が活発になっているからだ）
lines.english: (The fever… is because my processing activity has increased.)

lines.japanese:
邑西からは『できたらいつも氷嚢を装着していて
欲しい』という、冗談とも本気ともつかない提案を
受けている。
lines.english: Yuuzai had suggested that, if possible, he should ‘keep an ice pack on at all times,’ and Shinobu still could not tell whether he had been joking.

lines.japanese: （……本気なんだろうな）
lines.english: (…He was serious, wasn't he?)

lines.japanese:
笑っていなかったから。
　言うなれば忍は耐熱仕様である。
　多少の熱では、活動する力は失われない。
lines.english: He had not been smiling. One might say Shinobu was built to withstand heat. A modest fever did not deprive him of the strength to function.

lines.japanese:
ＥＳセルの力もあるが、それ以外にも体内に仕掛
けられた歪な新技術は、１１年の間に独自の発展を
遂げている。
lines.english: The ES cells contributed, but the other distorted new technologies embedded in his body had also undergone their own development over the past eleven years.

lines.japanese:
忍自身、すべてを使いこなせていない状態だ。
　移植当初は単純な分子構造だった細胞も、今では
複雑怪奇なものに変質した。
lines.english: Even Shinobu could not yet command all of them. The cells, molecularly simple when first implanted, had now transformed into things of bewildering complexity.

lines.japanese:
決して無駄な発展ではない。
　が、忍自身は、自らの変貌を恐ろしく感じること
もあった。
lines.english: That development was by no means wasted. Even so, Shinobu sometimes found the changes within himself frightening.

lines.japanese: （人じゃなくなりそうでさ……）
lines.english: (It feels as if I'm going to stop being human…)

lines.japanese:
もし忍が攻撃的な性格をしていたら、事実、人を
超えたものになっていただろう。
　変わろうと思えば、なんだって変わるものだ。
lines.english: Had Shinobu been aggressive by nature, he would probably have become something beyond human. Anything could change if it wanted to.

lines.japanese:
彼に施された処置は、それだけの可能性を秘めて
いた。
lines.english: The procedures performed on him contained that much potential.

lines.japanese: だが戦争を前にして、忍はいまだ人だった―――
lines.english: Yet on the eve of war, Shinobu remained human—
“…Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
背後に立った高密度の気配は、稼働状態にある忍
にとって、唐突な出来事ではなかった。
lines.english: The dense presence behind him came as no surprise to Shinobu, now that he was operational.

lines.japanese:
平野部に忍が立ち、対象が密閉された建物に閉じ
こもらない限り、忍はそれを感知することができる。
lines.english: So long as Shinobu stood on open ground and the target did not shut itself inside a sealed building, he could detect it.

lines.japanese: ……さほど便利な力ではない。副産物である。
lines.english: …It was not an especially useful power. Merely a by-product.

lines.japanese: もとよりセンシング能力など、忍には必要ない。
lines.english: Shinobu had never needed a sensory ability in the first place.

lines.japanese: 「第二次敷設計画も、一通り終わったみたいだね」
lines.english: “It looks like the second deployment plan is more or less complete.”

lines.japanese: 「聞いていたのか」
lines.english: “Were you listening?”

lines.japanese: 忍は薄く笑った。
lines.english: A faint smile touched Shinobu's lips.

lines.japanese: 「まさか」
lines.english: “Of course not.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだったな」
lines.english: “…Right.”

lines.japanese: 「最適化、終わったということか？」
lines.english: “Does that mean the optimization is complete?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まだ全部は」
lines.english: “No. Not all of it.”

lines.japanese:
半稼働状態である。
　今はまだ、膨大な情報の受け入れ態勢ができあが
っていない。
lines.english: He was only partially operational. He was not yet ready to receive that immense influx of information.

lines.japanese:
王としてふさわしい耐久力を確立するため、この
体はソフトウェア面の規格合わせ（デバッグ）に大忙
しなのだ。
lines.english: To establish the resilience befitting a king, his body was busy bringing its software up to spec—in other words, debugging itself.

lines.japanese:
開通した瞬間、忍は本当の意味で王になる。
　王、すなわち最上位ノード。
　全ての現象行使者に冠絶する、処理能力である。
lines.english: The instant the connection opened, Shinobu would become a king in truth. A king—the highest-order node. His processing power would surpass that of every wielder of phenomena.

lines.japanese:
処理能力。
　そう、厳密な意味で忍の能力はそれだけだ。
　万能管理権限。
lines.english: Processing power. Strictly speaking, that was Shinobu’s sole ability. Universal administrative authority.

lines.japanese:
他に何がいるというのだろう？
　王に相応しい絶対的な力である。
　だがえてして、権力は重圧をともなう。
lines.english: What else could he possibly need? It was absolute power, worthy of a king. But power, as ever, brought pressure with it.

lines.japanese:
大きな負担を、しかし忍は安定して維持している
ようだ。
lines.english: Yet Shinobu appeared to bear that tremendous burden without wavering.

lines.japanese:
今も、着実に地位への階段を昇っている。
　最適化が完了するのも遠くはない。
lines.english: Even now, he was climbing steadily toward the position awaiting him. The completion of his optimization was not far away.

lines.japanese: 「で、要件は？」
lines.english: “So, what do you need?”

lines.japanese: 返答がない。
lines.english: No answer came.

lines.japanese: 振り返る。
lines.english: Shinobu turned around.

lines.japanese: 南は緊張していた。
lines.english: Minami was tense.

lines.japanese: 「心拍数に変化があるね。どうかした？」
lines.english: “There's been a change in your heart rate. Is something wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「……雰囲気が、変わったか？」
lines.english: “…Has something about you changed?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ」
lines.english: “Who knows?”

lines.japanese: 肩をすくめる。
lines.english: He shrugged.

lines.japanese: 「機嫌、悪いから……そのせいかもね」
lines.english: “I'm in a bad mood… Maybe that's it.”

lines.japanese:
乾いた口調で言う。
　普段となんら変わらない瞳に、燃えるような虹色
が渦巻く。
lines.english: His voice was dry. A burning rainbow swirled in eyes otherwise no different from usual.

lines.japanese: 煌々と輝く視線が、南を射竦める。
lines.english: That incandescent gaze pinned Minami in place.

lines.japanese: 「そうか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
鍛えられた異能兵士は、動転しない。
　だが、内心はどうだったろう？
lines.english: The trained paranormal soldier did not flinch. But what had he felt inside?

lines.japanese: 「その変化、良い傾向だと思いたいがな」
lines.english: “I'd like to believe that change is a good sign.”

lines.japanese: とファイルを手渡す。
lines.english: He handed Shinobu a file.

lines.japanese: 「これは？」
lines.english: “What's this?”

lines.japanese: 「見ての通り、書類だ」
lines.english: “As you can see, a document.”

lines.japanese: 開いてみる。
lines.english: Shinobu opened it.

lines.japanese:
「……シークレット・ファイルって書いてある
　けど……」
lines.english: “…It says ‘Secret File’ on the cover…”

lines.japanese: 「まごうことなきシークレット・ファイルだ」
lines.english: “It is, unmistakably, a secret file.”

lines.japanese:
「疑ってるわけじゃなくて……重要書類の回覧なん
　てするわけ？」
lines.english: “I'm not doubting you… but do people really pass classified documents around like this?”

lines.japanese:
「その書類は、計画の実行に当たってごく一部の現場
　スタッフだけが見るもの。つまり……俺とおまえ
　だけだ」
lines.english: “Only a tiny number of field personnel will see that document during the operation. In other words… you and me.”

lines.japanese: 「…………なるほど」
「見たらこの場で廃棄する」
lines.english: “Once you've read it, I'll dispose of it here.”

lines.japanese: 言われて、忍は目を通す。
lines.english: At that, Shinobu began to read.

lines.japanese:
「何が書いてあるかと思えば……分散していた中核
　スタッフを集めるってことなのかな、これは？」
lines.english: “So that’s what this is… You’re gathering the core personnel who were scattered around?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「集めて、どうなるんだろう」
lines.english: “And what happens once they're gathered?”

lines.japanese:
「守りやすくなる。
　防衛的見地から、と理由が書いてあるだろう」
lines.english: “They'll be easier to protect. It says the move is being made for defensive reasons.”

lines.japanese: 「何から守るって？」
lines.english: “Protect them from what?”

lines.japanese: 「決まっている」
lines.english: “You know the answer.”

lines.japanese: あまりにも淡々と、異能兵士は告げる。
lines.english: The paranormal soldier told him with perfect calm.
“Human beings—”

lines.japanese: 「……人間、だって？」
lines.english: “…Human beings?”

lines.japanese: 「充分、考えられることだ」
lines.english: “It's entirely plausible.”

lines.japanese:
「大陸側にも、計画のことを知っている国は多い。
　快く思わないところがほとんどだろう」
lines.english: “Many countries on the continent know about the plan. Most of them are unlikely to welcome it.”

lines.japanese:
「彼らが我々をどの程度、脅威とするか……
　それは未知数だが」
lines.english: “How great a threat they consider us… remains unknown.”

lines.japanese:
「だって、向こうにもスタッフは何人も流れている
　んだろう？」
lines.english: “But several of our people have gone over to their side, haven't they?”

lines.japanese:
傭兵として。
　あるいは指導員として。
lines.english: As mercenaries. Or as instructors.

lines.japanese:
敷設計画自体が消滅しても、異能兵士技術のスピ
ンオフは活発に行われている。
lines.english: Even after the deployment plan itself was abandoned, paranormal-soldier technology continued to generate new spin-offs.

lines.japanese:
王のいない状態で、ネット自体の強度や殲滅力を
高めるには、個々の端末の数自体を増加させるしか
ない。
lines.english: Without a king, the only way to increase the network's resilience and destructive power was to increase the number of individual terminals.

lines.japanese:
統合されない、烏合の衆。
　だが統治者たちの思惑では、それは有効な手段と
された。
lines.english: An unintegrated rabble. Yet their rulers deemed it an effective strategy.

lines.japanese:
暗愚な輩が、人の未来を塗りつぶす。
　人類の業という色彩に。
lines.english: Fools painted over humanity's future in the color of humanity's own sin.

lines.japanese:
「個々のスタッフには、意趣替えする者だっている
　だろう」
lines.english: “Some individual staff members could always decide to change sides.”

lines.japanese:
「特に日米に対して、敵意を隠しもしない国は、確
　かに存在する」
lines.english: “There are certainly countries that make no attempt to hide their hostility toward Japan and the United States.”

lines.japanese:
「大陸と日米の間には、様々な抑止力はあるが……
　存外、国の判断というものは個人の感情に左右さ
　れるものだ」
lines.english: “There are many deterrents between the continental powers and Japan and the United States... but a nation's decisions are more often shaped by individual emotions than you might think.”

lines.japanese:
「そのような連中は、我々の実体を知りたいと思う
　かもしれん。そして、大枚を積んで引き込みをは
　かるかもしれん」
lines.english: “People like that may want to learn what we truly are. They may offer vast sums to lure our people away.”

lines.japanese:
「破局を前にした動乱期に、そういった感情が暴発
　する可能性は低くない。特に、外交という概念が
　凍結された現状においては、だ」
lines.english: “In the turmoil before catastrophe, there is a significant chance those emotions will erupt—especially now, with the very concept of diplomacy frozen.”

lines.japanese: 「外部の敵ばかりじゃなくて、同族まで……か」
lines.english: “So it isn't only outside enemies. Even our own kind...”

lines.japanese: 「だが、我々にはおまえがいる」
lines.english: “But we have you.”

lines.japanese:
「そう来ると思ったから、イヤだったんだ。
　僕は、身に過ぎた責任を負うつもりは―――」
lines.english: “I knew you’d say that. That’s what I didn’t want to hear. I’m not going to take on more responsibility than I can handle—”

lines.japanese: 「自分に意志があると思うから、そんな言葉が出る」
lines.english: “You say that because you imagine you have a will of your own.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだって」
lines.english: “What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 声が低まる。
lines.english: His voice dropped.

lines.japanese: 「兵士に意志はない。王にも、意志はない」
lines.english: “A soldier has no will. Neither does a king.”

lines.japanese: 「人にロボットになれって？」
lines.english: “You expect a human being to become a robot?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ自身が、その体現者だ」
lines.english: “You’re living proof of it.”

lines.japanese: 忍の呼吸が止まる。
lines.english: Shinobu stopped breathing.

lines.japanese:
「イヤなら、自決でもしろ。
　それをしないなら、受け入れているも同然だ」
lines.english: “If you don't like it, kill yourself. If you won't, then you've accepted it in all but name.”

lines.japanese: 「……そんなことはしない」
lines.english: “…I won't do that.”

lines.japanese: 「事実、他に手はないんだ」
lines.english: “The fact is, there is no other way.”

lines.japanese: 「どんな者も、おまえの力に従うしかない」
lines.english: “Everyone will have no choice but to submit to your power.”

lines.japanese:
「倫理は、生き残ってから考えればいいことだ。
　違うか？」
lines.english: “We can think about ethics after we survive. Am I wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「生き残れば、ね」
lines.english: “If we survive.”

lines.japanese: 「その可能性が、あると思うかい？」
lines.english: “Do you think there's any chance of that?”

lines.japanese: 南は強い視線を発する、瞳をひととき、閉じた。
lines.english: For a moment, Minami closed the eyes that had fixed him so fiercely.

lines.japanese: 「……ないだろうな」
lines.english: “…Probably not.”

lines.japanese:
開いた時、南の表情は何一つ変わっていなかった。
　宿っている感情だけが、痛切に感じられた。
lines.english: When he opened them, nothing in Minami's expression had changed. Only the emotion behind it came through with painful clarity.

lines.japanese: 「だけど俺は、最後まで頑張りたい……」
lines.english: “But I want to keep trying until the end...”
“…Minami.”

lines.japanese:
「異能兵士として生まれて、何一つ、成し遂げるこ
　ともなく……終わりたくはない」
lines.english: “I was born a paranormal soldier. I don't want to reach the end without accomplishing a single thing...”

lines.japanese:
「おまえは、違うのか？　違うんだろうな……おまえ
　は、俺たちとは違うものを見ている気がする……
　大切なものがある者の目をしている……」
lines.english: “Don't you feel the same? No... I suppose you don't. I feel as if you're looking at something different from the rest of us... You have the eyes of someone who has something precious...”

lines.japanese:
南は、泣いていた。
　能面の顔から、水滴だけが流れ落ちる。
lines.english: Minami was crying. Only tears moved across a face as still as a Noh mask.
“You…”

lines.japanese:
「自分がここにいることを、確かめたい。そのためだ
　ったら何でもする。それは相田も、ジーンも変わり
　はない。俺たちの誰もが、存在意義を求めている」
lines.english: “I want proof that I exist here. For that, I'll do anything. Yuu Aida and Gene are no different. Every one of us is searching for a reason to exist.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえがそれをくれるというなら、俺たちの中に
　文句を吐く者などいない」
lines.english: “If you can give us that, none of us will complain.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえが、王になってくれるというなら―――」
lines.english: “If you will become our king—”

lines.japanese:
重い、気持ち。
　ままならない立場。
　得られない福音。
lines.english: A heavy heart. A position beyond his control. A gospel beyond reach.

lines.japanese: なら人並みの人生などは、望むべくもないとわかる。
lines.english: Then he knew he could not hope for an ordinary life.

lines.japanese: 「だけど南……僕は……」
lines.english: “But Minami… I…”

lines.japanese:
「僕は、苦しいんだ。これからしなければならない
　こと、その結果、そして自分が消えてなくなって
　しまうことも」
lines.english: “I'm in pain. Because of what I have to do from here on, because of what it will cause, and because I will disappear completely.”

lines.japanese:
「誰も生き残らない。誰も。きっとそれは、決定的
　な破局なんだ」
lines.english: “No one will survive. No one. It will be the final catastrophe.”

lines.japanese:
「だとしても、ただ待っているだけの滅びなど
　は―――」
lines.english: “Even so, to do nothing but wait for extinction—”

lines.japanese: 「わかるよ。わかるけど……」
lines.english: “I know. I know, but…”

lines.japanese:
「本当は、仲間と一緒に、ゆっくりと受け入れたい
　と思ったんだッ」
lines.english: “What I really wanted was to accept it slowly, together with my friends!”

lines.japanese:
南の袖をつかむ。
　下から、見上げる。
lines.english: He clutched Minami's sleeve. Looked up at him from below.

lines.japanese: 「それを壊したのは、君たちじゃないか」
lines.english: “You're the ones who destroyed that.”

lines.japanese:
「返せなんて言わない。だけど……
　当の君たちが、与えてくれと僕に言うのか」
lines.english: “I won't ask you to give it back. But… now you're the ones asking me to give you something?”

lines.japanese: 「搾取ではなく、自分の意志で！」
lines.english: “By my own free will, not through exploitation!”

lines.japanese:
「……忍……
　樋口章二のことは不幸だったとは思うが……」
lines.english: “...Shinobu... What happened to Shouji Higuchi was tragic, but...”

lines.japanese: 「嘘をつくな！」
lines.english: “Don't lie!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえたちがそんなことを考えるはずはない！」
lines.english: “You people would never think that!”

lines.japanese: 胸元にすがりつく。
lines.english: He clutched at the front of Minami's clothes.

lines.japanese: 「……思ってもいないことを、言うな……ばか」
lines.english: “…Don't say things you don't mean… idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「すまない」
lines.english: “I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: すでに南は平常に戻っている。
lines.english: Minami had already regained his composure.

lines.japanese: 「ただ、一つ頭に入れておくといい」
lines.english: “Just remember one thing.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえをつついたのは確かに俺の指示によって行
　われたことだ。が、たとえ俺がいなくとも、あい
　つらは同じことをしただろう」
lines.english: “It is true that I ordered them to prod you into action. But even without me, they would have done the same thing.”

lines.japanese: 「ことによれば、人質を取ってでも」
lines.english: “Even if it meant taking a hostage.”

lines.japanese:
「驚くことじゃないさ。
　それだけ、俺たちは切羽詰まっていたんだ」
lines.english: “That shouldn't surprise you. That is how desperate we were.”

lines.japanese:
